title: High Volume SSH Authentication Failure on Bastion-01
description: Over 14,000 failed SSH login attempts detected from untrusted external IP within a 15-minute window targeting privileged root account.

evidence.sample_log: Sep 25 14:22:08 bastion-prod-01 sshd[38411]: Failed password for root from 198.51.100.45 port 49122 ssh2

analysis.summary: External threat actor executing distributed dictionary attack against edge bastion SSH service.
analysis.potential_impact: Unauthorized shell access to production perimeter network

actions_taken: Applied edge firewall DROP rule for IP 198.51.100.45
Audited /etc/ssh/sshd_config and discovered PasswordAuthentication was set to yes
Modified sshd_config: set PasswordAuthentication no and PubkeyAuthentication yes
Restarted sshd service and validated existing open sessions
resolution.outcome: Contained successfully within 12 minutes. Zero unauthorized sessions established. Password authentication disabled across bastion fleet.

postmortem.root_cause: Routine OS package upgrade on bastion-prod-01 overwrote /etc/ssh/sshd_config with package maintainer defaults, inadvertently enabling password authentication.
postmortem.lessons_learned: Enforce automated Ansible compliance check on all perimeter servers every 15 minutes to guarantee PasswordAuthentication no is permanently set. Deploy fail2ban as an immediate perimeter circuit breaker.
